dedupe_keys.name: goldsim for mine water and waste management

description: A commercial probabilistic simulation platform widely used for mine site water and waste systems. The GoldSim mining page says the software is a general probabilistic simulation framework with modules for water quality and contaminant transport and for reliability, used for mine water management and site water balances, contaminant transport, evaluation of closure options, material logistics and the reliability and throughput of processing plants, and that it has been used at hundreds of mine sites. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (GoldSim). Access is paid. Coverage is any mine site the user models. Caveats: results depend on the user's site model and input distributions. For simulation it supports Monte Carlo analysis of how droughts, extreme rainfall or equipment failures affect mine water storage, spills, tailings and processing throughput. The page lists technical papers on coupling it with PHREEQC, FEFLOW and Muk3D. A related catalogue record is the Muk3D tailings modelling software.
